articles.headline: Larsen & Toubro Secures $1.57B AI Data Centre Order
articles.whyItMatters: Signals massive infrastructure spending on artificial intelligence capabilities in India.
articles.brief: Engineering giant Larsen and Toubro has secured a major contract worth up to $1.57 billion to construct an advanced AI data centre in India, highlighting rapid technological expansion.

articles.headline: Google Unveils Gemini 3.7 Flash AI Model
articles.whyItMatters: Advances coding capabilities and agent workflows in enterprise software development.
articles.brief: Google has announced the release of Gemini 3.7 Flash, an advanced artificial intelligence model designed to enhance coding tasks and complex automated agent workflows.

articles.headline: UAE Reports Attack on Two ADNOC Vessels
articles.whyItMatters: Escalates maritime security threats and geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.
articles.brief: The UAE has confirmed that Iran attacked two ADNOC vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, though no injuries were reported amidst soaring regional conflict.

articles.headline: US Navy Blockade on Iranian Ports Can Last Indefinitely
articles.whyItMatters: Demonstrates long-term strategic military commitment by Washington against Tehran.
articles.brief: The Pentagon chief stated that the United States possesses the capacity to maintain its naval blockade on Iranian ports indefinitely as economic warfare intensifies.

articles.headline: Hillhouse Plans to Double India Investments
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights growing foreign direct investment confidence in Indian real estate and data sectors.
articles.brief: Singapore-based Hillhouse is scaling up its presence in India with plans to double its investments, focusing heavily on real estate and critical digital infrastructure.

articles.headline: US Court Backs Power to Close Tariff Loopholes
articles.whyItMatters: Strengthens executive authority over trade enforcement and de minimis exemption rules.
articles.brief: A federal court has delivered a major victory to the administration by upholding its authority to close tariff exemptions and tackle lost trade revenue.

articles.headline: Uttarakhand Tunnel Collapse Leaves Six Workers Dead
articles.whyItMatters: Raises renewed concerns over safety protocols in major Himalayan infrastructure projects.
articles.brief: Six workers lost their lives and several others were injured after sudden water and debris rushed into an under-construction hydroelectric tunnel in Chamoli.

articles.headline: North Korea Condemns New US Nuclear Strategy
articles.whyItMatters: Warns of an escalating regional arms race on the Korean peninsula.
articles.brief: Pyongyang has slammed upcoming military drills between the US and South Korea, stating that Washington's revised nuclear strategy will trigger a dangerous arms race.

articles.headline: US Colleges Face Major Drop in Foreign Students
articles.whyItMatters: Impacts higher education revenue and international student enrollment trends, particularly from India.
articles.brief: Stricter visa policies and processing shifts are projected to cause a massive 110,000 drop in foreign student enrollment across American universities this year.

articles.headline: Air India Expands Drug Testing for All Pilots
articles.whyItMatters: Enforces stricter workplace safety and compliance standards within commercial aviation.
articles.brief: Following a pilot testing positive for marijuana, Air India has officially expanded its mandatory drug testing protocol to cover all active cockpit crew members.

articles.headline: Food Safety Checks Expose Gaps in Bengaluru
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights vulnerabilities in urban food supply chains and regulatory enforcement.
articles.brief: Recent food safety inspections across Bengaluru restaurants and quick-commerce warehouses reveal that higher pricing does not guarantee compliance with safety standards.

articles.headline: Rapido Secures Five-Year Cab Licence in Karnataka
articles.whyItMatters: Strengthens ride-hailing market competition and regulatory clarity for aggregators.
articles.brief: The Karnataka government has granted Rapido a five-year cab operating licence valid through August 2031, providing long-term stability for its transport services.

articles.headline: Harry Brook Open to Indian Premier League Return
articles.whyItMatters: Reignites international player participation discussions within premier cricket leagues.
articles.brief: England white-ball captain Harry Brook has reversed his stance, expressing openness to an eventual return to the Indian Premier League despite prior bans.

articles.headline: Esports Aims for Mainstream Appeal Like IPL
articles.whyItMatters: Reflects the commercial evolution and shifting cultural status of competitive gaming.
articles.brief: Industry executives at the Esports World Cup are actively pushing to model player fandom and mainstream cultural recognition after traditional cricket leagues.

articles.headline: Opposition Wrests Narrative in Paralysed Parliament
articles.whyItMatters: Underscores intensifying political gridlock and legislative standoff in national governance.
articles.brief: The parliamentary session faced severe disruption as opposition parties leveraged key policy absence and legislative bills to corner the ruling coalition.
